title: PRP for Ovaries vs. Adipose-PRP: Which Rejuvenation Option Fits You?
meta_title: PRP for Ovaries vs. Adipose-PRP: Which Fits You?
meta_description: PRP for the ovaries or adipose-PRP? See how each works, what the trials show, who each suits, and how to time IVF to get the most from treatment.
excerpt: PRP for the ovaries uses growth factors from your blood; adipose-PRP adds your own fat-derived cells. Here is how each works, what the research shows, who each suits and how to time IVF afterwards.
serp_gap: Top results describe plain blood-only PRP; none compare it with adipose-PRP (the patient's own fat-derived cells mixed with PRP), say who each suits, or explain what the two randomized trials mean for when to time egg retrieval after treatment.
